node_kinds.invariant: Exactly one normalized canonical official documentation route observation.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Route, heading, parameter-section, return-section or example-section presence is not behavioral, runtime or package-version truth.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on page-digest change; -> invalidated on route removal, canonical-identity change, or selector disappearance; historical row may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: One version-scoped program identity within an explicit JS, WAAPI, namespace or adapter surface.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Equal labels, adjacent pages or examples do not establish symbol identity or JS/WAAPI parity.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on compatible source/type drift; -> invalidated on export removal or identity contradiction; -> superseded only by another APISymbol with the same logical identity.

node_kinds.invariant: One scoped proposition derived from immutable official bytes.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: A SourceFact is not an EvidenceRecord, runtime observation, inference, recommendation or authority grant.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review when intersecting bytes change without a demonstrated contradiction; -> invalidated when selector fails or intersecting evidence contradicts the proposition; same-kind replacement may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: One official example locator plus an original purpose description.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Source presence does not prove execution, correctness, accessibility, performance or production behavior.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on locator or digest drift; -> invalidated on removal; execution status changes only through a new ExecutedWitness.

node_kinds.invariant: Ordered, non-executing guidance with explicit prerequisites, consultation bindings, validation requirement and abstention behavior.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: A Recipe is not a Task, Fix, Recommendation, execution authorization or verified Lesson.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on prerequisite, source or compatible-version drift; -> invalidated on contradicted required action; same-kind revision may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: One requested intent with target, constraints and acceptance condition.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Intent does not prove feasibility, correctness, execution or completion.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> invalidated only on cancellation; a materially revised intent becomes a new Task and old Task -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: Append-only envelope for one bounded execution effort against exactly one Task and VersionContext.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Existence or closure is not successful Outcome, production change or Lesson.
node_kinds.validity: reproduced while open -> validated when closed and structurally complete; corrupt receipt -> invalidated; correction requires a distinct superseding episode.

node_kinds.invariant: One ordinal action within exactly one WorkEpisode.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: An Attempt is not Evidence and cannot directly support a Diagnosis or Lesson.
node_kinds.validity: append-only; validated when its ordinal and episode ownership are valid; corrupt ordering or cross-episode ownership -> invalidated.

node_kinds.invariant: A scoped observation statement bound to a witness and VersionContext.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Observation is not explanation or root cause.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on context incompatibility; -> invalidated if witness integrity fails.

node_kinds.invariant: Defeasible explanation with explicit premises, confidence and contradiction handling.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: A Diagnosis is not SourceFact, Fix or successful Outcome.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on potentially affected premise drift; -> invalidated on load-bearing premise invalidation or unresolved direct contradiction; revised diagnosis may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: One candidate change addressing one named Diagnosis.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Proposal or application does not imply a successful Outcome.
node_kinds.validity: validated as proposal -> stale-pending-review on changed preconditions; -> invalidated if diagnosis is invalidated or change becomes incompatible; revised Fix may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: Terminal classification of one Attempt with exact witness references.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Success applies only to the declared criterion and environment.
node_kinds.validity: validated only when status and evidence satisfy the criterion; integrity failure -> invalidated; Outcome is never rewritten.

node_kinds.invariant: Conditional guidance generalized from compatible closed WorkEpisodes with Outcomes.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Not SourceFact, Recipe, Recommendation or universal truth. Current verified Anime.js Lesson count must remain zero.
node_kinds.validity: candidate -> verified only with a closed episode, succeeded Outcome and TestObserved or ExecutedWitness; verified -> stale-pending-review on intersecting drift; -> invalidated on contradiction or failed applicability; revised Lesson may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: Carrier for one bounded evidence assertion, never the assertion itself.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Evidence status, record presence and authority are separate; present tests/examples are not executed evidence.
node_kinds.validity: returned-not-written -> reproduced -> validated; intersecting drift -> stale-pending-review; integrity or contradiction failure -> invalidated; replacement may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: Immutable compatibility tuple, not a loose version label.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Documentation cache markers and mutable-site observations cannot establish release version.
node_kinds.validity: validated immutable tuple; changed component creates a new VersionContext and old may -> superseded; discovered integrity error -> invalidated.

node_kinds.invariant: Explicit premises, rule, conclusion, uncertainty and contradiction policy.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Cannot masquerade as SourceFact, Outcome or official guidance.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on potentially affected premise drift; -> invalidated when any load-bearing premise is invalidated.

node_kinds.invariant: Project-local choice with alternatives, constraints and evidence ceiling.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Not Anime.js authority, Recipe, Fix or execution authorization.
node_kinds.validity: validated -> stale-pending-review on changed constraints/evidence; -> invalidated by owner withdrawal; replacement may -> superseded.

node_kinds.invariant: Retrieval-only third-party proposal with no admissible guidance effect.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Issue 1105 cannot support Recipe, Fix, Lesson, official guidance, performance or workflow claims.
node_kinds.validity: validated only as proposal presence; source removal/change -> stale-pending-review or invalidated; promotion requires a new independently admitted record.

node_kinds.invariant: One exact missing binding or witness with affected claim, closure condition and owner.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: Absence is not negative proof.
node_kinds.validity: validated while missing; -> superseded when a closure record names the satisfying evidence; never silently deleted.

node_kinds.invariant: One non-executing question that can close one EvidenceGap.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: A question or route suggestion does not authorize or execute work.
node_kinds.validity: validated while its gap remains open; -> superseded when resolved or replaced.

node_kinds.invariant: Immutable persisted output of one deterministic query over one exact graph digest.
node_kinds.misuse_warning: A QueryReceipt is not canonical knowledge, approval, execution or authority.
node_kinds.validity: validated only while source graph digest and algorithm version match; drift -> stale-pending-review; superseding rerun creates a new receipt.
